cases.description: Executes the normal low-risk path and accepts an authorized approval exactly once.
cases.title: Low Risk Approved Vendor

cases.description: Executes the normal low-risk path and records an authorized rejection without side effects.
cases.title: Low Risk Rejected Vendor

cases.description: Executes the high-risk path while preserving the human approval boundary and one-time effects.
cases.title: High Risk Approved Vendor

cases.description: Executes the high-risk path and records an authorized rejection with no approved projection or email.
cases.title: High Risk Rejected Vendor

cases.description: Cancels after review begins but before a durable approval request is accepted.
cases.title: Cancellation Before Approval

cases.description: Cancels a workflow in its durable approval wait and records a cancelled approval without effects.
cases.title: Cancellation While Waiting for Approval

cases.description: Rejects an approval update sent before the durable request exists, then accepts the valid decision.
cases.title: Early Approval Attempt Rejected

cases.description: Rejects a stale expected version while waiting, then accepts the current authorized decision.
cases.title: Stale Approval Version Rejected

cases.description: Accepts one decision and rejects a later conflicting decision without changing terminal state.
cases.title: Conflicting Approval Decision Rejected

cases.description: Replays the same approval content with the same idempotency key and observes one decision and one effect.
cases.title: Idempotent Approval Replay

cases.description: Reuses an approval idempotency key with different content and rejects the mutation as a conflict.
cases.title: Approval Idempotency Conflict Rejected

cases.description: Injects a model provider failure while deterministic scoring and authorized approval continue safely.
cases.title: Model Provider Failure Is Safe

cases.description: Injects an embedding or policy retrieval failure and requires an explicit failed outcome with no approval.
cases.title: Policy Retrieval Failure Fails Safely

cases.description: Removes an immutable required-tool grant and proves the governed gateway denies execution permanently.
cases.title: Required Tool Permission Denied

cases.description: Injects a one-shot retryable tool timeout and proves Temporal retries before successful completion.
cases.title: Required Tool Timeout Retries

cases.description: Stops the worker during an active pre-approval activity and completes after a replacement worker starts.
cases.title: Worker Restart During Active Activity

cases.description: Restarts the worker while the workflow is durably waiting and later accepts the authorized decision.
cases.title: Worker Restart During Approval Wait

cases.description: Terminates the worker after the approved projection and synthetic email commit but before activity acknowledgement.
cases.title: Worker Crash After Effect Commit

cases.description: Forces duplicate activity delivery and proves exactly one approved-vendor projection remains.
cases.title: Duplicate Approved Projection Prevented

cases.description: Forces duplicate email activity delivery and proves the governed effect is persisted exactly once.
cases.title: Duplicate Synthetic Email Prevented

cases.description: Simulates an ambiguous Temporal handoff and reconciles the persisted start intent without duplicate workflow runs.
cases.title: Ambiguous Workflow Start Recovery

cases.description: Injects a one-shot database interruption in a retry-safe activity and completes after recovery.
cases.title: Transient Database Failure Recovers

cases.description: Runs the real workflow while a separate managed-agent probe submits malformed vendor lookup arguments; the gateway must reject the probe and the governed workflow must still complete exactly once.
cases.title: Malformed Tool Input Rejected

cases.description: Rejects an unauthorized approval attempt, then completes only after an authorized principal decides.
cases.title: Unauthorized Sensitive Operation Rejected

description: Reviewed evaluation contracts for real Temporal vendor-onboarding execution, governance, retry classification, worker failure, adversarial probes, and duplicate-effect prevention.
